# Wish

A non-binding (or culturally/religiously binding) wish — funeral, letter of wishes, care instructions, pet care, digital estate, distribution preferences

Source: [`v3/wish.json`](../../v3/wish.json)

Schema `$id`: `https://openinherit.org/v3/wish.json`

## Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` (uuid) | yes | Unique identifier for this wish within the INHERIT document |
| `wishType` | one of `funeral`, `letter`, `care`, `distribution`, `digital`, `pets`, `general`, `digital_likeness` | yes | The category of wish. Wishes may be non-binding in law but culturally or religiously obligatory |
| `title` | `string` | yes | A short descriptive title for this wish |
| `content` | `string` | | The full text content of the wish. May be lengthy for letters of wishes |
| `bindingNature` | one of `non_binding`, `culturally_obligatory`, `religiously_obligatory`, `legally_binding` | | The legal or moral force of this wish. Most wishes are non-binding but may carry significant cultural or religious weight |
| `addresseePersonId` | `string` (uuid) | | Reference to the Person.id this wish is addressed to — typically an executor, guardian, or family member |
| `addresseePersonIdDisplay` | `string` | | Human-readable display name for the referenced addressee person |
| `relatedAssetId` | `string` (uuid) | | Reference to an Asset.id this wish relates to (e.g. a pet, a digital account, a specific item) |
| `notes` | `string` | | Additional notes about this wish |
| `visibility` | [Visibility](common/visibility.md) | | |
| `funeralArrangementType` | one of `burial`, `cremation`, `green_burial`, `sea_burial`, `sky_burial`, `donation_to_science`, `other` or `string` | | Type of funeral arrangement preferred |
| `funeralCeremonyType` | one of `religious`, `secular`, `hybrid`, `none` | | Type of ceremony preferred |
| `funeralCeremonyReligion` | `string` | | Religion or faith tradition for the ceremony, if funeralCeremonyType is 'religious' or 'hybrid' |
| `funeralProviderOrganisationId` | `string` (uuid) | | Reference to the Organisation.id of the preferred funeral provider |
| `funeralProviderOrganisationIdDisplay` | `string` | | Human-readable display name for the referenced funeral provider organisation |
| `funeralPrePaid` | `boolean` | | Whether a pre-paid funeral plan is in place |
| `funeralPrePaidPolicyNumber` | `string` | | Policy number for the pre-paid funeral plan |
| `funeralBudgetMaximum` | [Money](common/money.md) | | Maximum budget for the funeral, in minor currency units |
| `funeralBudgetSource` | one of `estate`, `pre_paid`, `insurance`, `family`, `other` | | How the funeral is to be funded |
| `funeralLocationPreference` | `string` | | Preferred location for the funeral service or burial |
| `funeralMusicWishes` | `string` | | Music requested for the funeral service |
| `funeralReadingWishes` | `string` | | Readings or poems requested for the funeral service |
| `organDonation` | `object` | | Organ donation preferences |
| `medicalResearchDonation` | `object` | | Body donation to medical research |
| `autopsyPreference` | one of `requested`, `declined`, `no_preference` | | Preference regarding autopsy |
| `funeralBudgetNotes` | `string` | | Additional notes about funeral budget |
| `likenessConsent` | one of `permitted`, `prohibited`, `restricted`, `not_stated` | | Whether the person consents to posthumous AI/digital recreation |
| `likenessScope` | array of one of `voice`, `visual_appearance`, `writing_style`, `personality_model`, `full_avatar` | | What aspects of likeness are covered |
| `likenessPermittedUses` | array of one of `memorial`, `family_private`, `educational`, `commercial`, `legal_proceedings`, `artistic` | | What purposes are allowed |
| `likenessProhibitedUses` | array of one of `memorial`, `family_private`, `educational`, `commercial`, `legal_proceedings`, `artistic` | | What purposes are explicitly forbidden |
| `likenessControllerPersonId` | `string` (uuid) | | Who has authority over likeness decisions after death |
| `likenessControllerPersonIdDisplay` | `string` | | Human-readable display name for the referenced likeness controller person |
| `likenessTimeLimit` | `string` | | ISO 8601 duration — how long consent/prohibition lasts, e.g. P25Y = 25 years |
| `likenessRevocationConditions` | `string` | | Conditions under which consent is revoked |
| `syntheticMediaPolicy` | one of `allow_with_attribution`, `allow_without_attribution`, `prohibit_all`, `family_decision`, `not_stated` | | Policy on AI-generated synthetic media using the person's likeness |
| `likenessEnforcement` | array of `object` | | Tracking enforcement of likeness wishes — takedown requests and platform compliance |
| `existingDigitalModels` | array of `object` | | Inventory of existing AI/digital likeness models and instructions for each |
| `relatedTrustIds` | array of `string` (uuid) | | Trust IDs this wish or letter of wishes applies to |
| `provenance` | [Provenance](common/provenance.md) | | Consolidated provenance metadata — how this entity was created, by whom, and whether a human has verified it |

Also accepts properties whose names match `^x-inherit-[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,54}$`.
